atomic_xobject_cases.name: image_interpolate_true
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An Image dictionary explicitly enables interpolation.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: image_interpolate_false
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An explicit false Interpolate value is permitted.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: image_bpc_16
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: A non-mask image uses a BitsPerComponent value outside 1, 2, 4, and 8.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: image_bpc_missing
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: The pinned predicate accepts a null or missing BitsPerComponent value.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: mask_bpc_8
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An ImageMask stencil is exempt from the normal image rule but does not instantiate veraPDF's PDMaskImage model object.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: mask_bpc_missing
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: The pinned image-mask predicate accepts a null or missing BitsPerComponent value.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: explicit_mask_bpc_8
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An image referenced through another Image dictionary's Mask key is modeled as a mask and must use one bit per component.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: form_ps_key
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: A Form XObject dictionary contains the forbidden PS key.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: form_ps_null
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: veraPDF does not expose containsPS for a null-valued PS entry.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: form_subtype2_ps
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: A Form XObject dictionary declares Subtype2 as PS.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: form_ref
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: A Form XObject dictionary contains the forbidden Ref key.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: postscript_xobject
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An invoked XObject has Subtype PS.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: unused_resource_invalid_image
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An invalid Image XObject present in page resources is inapplicable until a Do operator invokes it.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: unreferenced_invalid_image
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: An otherwise unreferenced indirect Image XObject is outside veraPDF's modeled XObject graph.

atomic_xobject_cases.name: two_invalid_images
atomic_xobject_cases.rationale: Two invalid Image XObjects aggregate into one local rule failure while veraPDF reports the same failed rule identifier.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: direct_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A direct ExtGState selected by gs contains a forbidden TR entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary contains the forbidden TR entry.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr2_default
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: TR2 is permitted when its value is the name Default.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_tr2_other
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary has a TR2 value other than Default.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An ExtGState resource is inapplicable until selected by the gs operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unreferenced_extgstate_tr
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An unreferenced ExtGState dictionary is outside veraPDF's modeled graphics-state graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: ri_standard
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: All four standard rendering-intent names are accepted by the ri operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: ri_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The ri operator selects a non-standard rendering-intent name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: extgstate_ri_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState dictionary contains a non-standard RI name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: image_intent_valid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked image uses the standard Perceptual Intent.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: image_intent_invalid
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An invoked image contains a non-standard Intent name.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_operator
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Page content contains an operator not defined by PDF 1.4.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_in_bx
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: PDF/A-1 rejects an undefined operator even inside BX and EX compatibility sections.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: known_operators
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Standard PDF 1.4 graphics operators remain accepted.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: graphics_state_nesting_28
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The PDF/A-1 graphics-state nesting limit is inclusive at 28 q operators.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: graphics_state_nesting_29
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The 29th nested q operator exceeds the PDF/A-1 graphics-state limit.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: undefined_form
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Content in an invoked Form contains an undefined operator.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: unused_form_undefined
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: Content in an uninvoked Form is outside veraPDF's modeled content graph.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image declares the forbidden LZWDecode filter.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw_array
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image includes LZWDecode in a filter array.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_lzw_escaped
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: PDF name hex escapes are decoded before matching the inline-image LZWDecode filter.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_ascii_hex
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: An executed inline image uses ASCIIHexDecode rather than LZW.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_false_ei
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: The letters EI embedded without PDF token boundaries in inline-image data do not terminate the image.

atomic_graphics_cases.name: inline_image_tokens_in_string
atomic_graphics_cases.rationale: BI, ID, EI, and LZW-looking text inside a literal string is not executable inline-image syntax.

atomic_font_cases.name: unembedded_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible TrueType font has no embedded font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_rendering_modes
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.28.2 retains rendering mode 3 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: mixed_visible_first
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF 1.28.2 retains visible mode 0 from the font's first text-show use.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A directly embedded Font resource dictionary still instantiates the rule.

atomic_font_cases.name: form_unembedded
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Visible text in a Form XObject uses an unembedded font.

atomic_font_cases.name: inherited_resources
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The page inherits its unembedded font resource from the Pages node.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_unembedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type0 is exempt directly, but its used unembedded CIDFont descendant is not.

atomic_font_cases.name: type0_embedded_descendant
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The CIDFont descendant is embedded; the synthetic font's unrelated glyph failure is recorded explicitly.

atomic_font_cases.name: type3_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: Type3 is exempt from the embedding rule; incomplete synthetic glyph data triggers unrelated rules.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_descriptor
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor resolving to an indirect valid font program is accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: direct_font_file
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A direct descriptor and direct valid font-file stream are accepted.

atomic_font_cases.name: malformed_font_program
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF does not expose containsFontFile for a stream whose bytes are not a recognized font program.

atomic_font_cases.name: graphics_state_visible
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A visible text-show inside q/Q records visible rendering mode.

atomic_font_cases.name: cyclic_form
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The used font is checked once while cyclic Form recursion is bounded.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_type_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used Font dictionary has no required Type entry.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_type_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used Font dictionary has a Type name other than Font.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_subtype_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF creates no PDFont model object when the Subtype entry is missing, so the predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_subtype_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: veraPDF creates no PDFont model object for an unsupported Subtype name, so the predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_basefont_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-Type3 Font dictionary has no BaseFont name.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_basefont_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-Type3 Font dictionary has a non-name BaseFont value.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_firstchar_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no FirstChar; its Widths-size expression consequently also fails.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_lastchar_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no LastChar; its Widths-size expression consequently also fails.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font has no Widths array.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_widths_wrong_size
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used non-standard simple font's Widths array length differs from LastChar minus FirstChar plus one.

atomic_font_cases.name: standard14_missing_metrics
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The standard Helvetica font is exempt from FirstChar, LastChar, and Widths.

atomic_font_cases.name: font_file_subtype_invalid
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A used font's embedded font stream declares a Subtype other than Type1C or CIDFontType0C.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_glyph_missing
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A rendered Type1C byte has no glyph in the embedded CFF program.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_glyph_present
atomic_font_cases.rationale: A rendered Type1C byte resolves to a glyph in the embedded CFF program.

atomic_font_cases.name: type1c_width_mismatch
atomic_font_cases.rationale: The embedded Type1C glyph width differs from the dictionary width by more than one unit.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_identity_v
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: Identity-V is exempt from CIDSystemInfo compatibility and CMap embedding, while the CIDToGIDMap is Identity.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_missing
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A visible Type 2 CIDFont descendant has no CIDToGIDMap.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_invalid_name
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A visible Type 2 CIDFont descendant uses a CIDToGIDMap name other than Identity.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidmap_stream
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded stream is a valid modeled CIDToGIDMap.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_named_cmap
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A non-Identity named CMap is not embedded and its Adobe/Japan1 system information conflicts with the Adobe/Identity CIDFont.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_cid_too_large
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded CMap maps codes to CIDs above the PDF/A-1 maximum of 65,535.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_matching
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An embedded CMap has matching CIDSystemInfo and matching default WMode values.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_mismatch_system
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap's Ordering differs from its CIDFont descendant's Ordering.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_wmode_match
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap stream and dictionary both declare WMode 1.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cmap_wmode_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: The embedded CMap stream declares WMode 0 while its dictionary declares WMode 1.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cid_subset_missing_cidset
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFont descriptor omits CIDSet for a rendered CID.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cidset_real_program
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFont CIDSet omits a rendered CID present in a real bounded font program.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_identity_width_mismatch
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: An Identity-H rendered CID width differs from the embedded TrueType width.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cff_cidset_missing
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFontType0C CIDSet omits the rendered CID.

atomic_composite_font_cases.name: composite_cff_present_glyph
atomic_composite_font_cases.rationale: A subset CIDFontType0C has both a rendered glyph and a CIDSet bit for its CID.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_macroman
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: MacRomanEncoding is valid for a non-symbolic TrueType font.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_missing_encoding
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A non-symbolic TrueType font has no Encoding.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_invalid_encoding
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: StandardEncoding is not permitted for a non-symbolic TrueType font.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_dictionary_winansi
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: An Encoding dictionary with WinAnsiEncoding BaseEncoding and no Differences is valid.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_dictionary_macroman
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: An Encoding dictionary with MacRomanEncoding BaseEncoding and no Differences is valid.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_nonsymbolic_differences
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A non-symbolic TrueType Encoding dictionary contains a forbidden Differences entry.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_symbolic_no_encoding
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A symbolic TrueType font has no Encoding and its embedded program contains one cmap subtable.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_symbolic_with_encoding
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A symbolic TrueType font specifies WinAnsiEncoding.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_symbolic_one_cmap
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A symbolic embedded TrueType program contains exactly one cmap subtable.

atomic_truetype_cases.name: tt_symbolic_two_cmaps
atomic_truetype_cases.rationale: A symbolic embedded TrueType program contains two cmap subtables.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_smask_none
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState may declare SMask None.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_smask_other
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState declares an SMask name other than None.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_smask_dictionary
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A used ExtGState declares a soft-mask dictionary rather than SMask None.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_bm_normal
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Normal is an allowed blend mode.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_bm_compatible
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Compatible is an allowed blend mode.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_stroke_alpha_one
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Stroke alpha CA equal to one is allowed.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_stroke_alpha_zero
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Stroke alpha CA equal to zero is forbidden.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_fill_alpha_one
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Fill alpha ca equal to one is allowed.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: extgstate_fill_alpha_zero
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: Fill alpha ca equal to zero is forbidden.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: unused_extgstate_transparency
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: An unused ExtGState resource creates no PDExtGState model object.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: xobject_smask
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: An invoked Image XObject contains an SMask key.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: unused_xobject_smask
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: An unused XObject resource creates no PDXObject model object.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: page_transparency_group
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A page dictionary contains a transparency Group.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: page_nontransparency_group
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A page Group whose S value is not Transparency passes the predicate.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: form_transparency_group
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: An invoked Form XObject contains a transparency Group.

atomic_transparency_cases.name: unused_form_transparency_group
atomic_transparency_cases.rationale: A Form resource that is never invoked creates no PDGroup model object.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: subtype_file_attachment
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: FileAttachment is forbidden in PDF/A-1.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: subtype_missing
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A page annotation dictionary has no Subtype.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: direct_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A direct dictionary in the page Annots array still instantiates PDAnnot.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: direct_page_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A Page dictionary embedded directly (not indirectly) in the page tree's Kids array is still walked; veraPDF validates its annotations exactly as it would an indirect page.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: unreferenced_invalid_annotation
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An annotation-like object absent from page Annots is inapplicable.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: opacity_zero
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation opacity CA is zero rather than one.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: opacity_wrong_type
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A nonnumeric CA is exposed as null by the pinned annotation model.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: flags_missing
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: An annotation has no required flags.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: flags_invisible
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: The Invisible flag is set despite the Print flag.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_rgb
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation colour is permitted with an RGB PDF/A-1 output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_c_cmyk
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation colour is used with a CMYK output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: color_ic_without_output
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: Annotation interior colour is used without a PDF/A-1 output profile.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: no_color_cmyk
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-RGB output profile is harmless when C and IC are absent.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button annotation has an AP dictionary containing only a stream-valued N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button annotation has a subdictionary-valued normal appearance.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_n_and_r
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: The appearance dictionary contains R in addition to N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_empty
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A present but empty appearance dictionary does not contain only N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: appearance_wrong_type
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-dictionary AP is exposed as null by the pinned annotation model.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget has a nonempty normal appearance subdictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_empty_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget has an empty normal appearance subdictionary.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_button_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A button Widget uses a stream rather than an appearance subdictionary for N.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_text_stream
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A non-button Widget has a stream-valued normal appearance.

atomic_annotation_cases.name: widget_inherited_button_dictionary
atomic_annotation_cases.rationale: A Widget inherits FT Btn from its parent field and has an appearance subdictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: allowed_named
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Named NextPage is one of the permitted action and name combinations.

atomic_action_cases.name: gotor_action_with_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A GoToR OpenAction's /F file specification contains /EF; veraPDF creates the same CosFileSpecification object and applies containsEF whether the file spec is reached through an action or the EmbeddedFiles name tree.

atomic_action_cases.name: submit_form_action_with_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A SubmitForm OpenAction's /F file specification contains /EF; confirmed to fire the same containsEF check as a GoToR action's file specification.

atomic_action_cases.name: gotor_action_without_ef_file_spec
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A GoToR action's file specification has no /EF entry, so containsEF passes for both validators.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A catalog OpenAction uses the forbidden JavaScript action type.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_missing_subtype
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A dictionary-valued OpenAction has no S name.

atomic_action_cases.name: open_destination_array
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An array-valued OpenAction is a destination and does not instantiate PDAction.

atomic_action_cases.name: unreferenced_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unreferenced action-looking dictionary is outside the action model.

atomic_action_cases.name: page_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The O trigger in page AA reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: page_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unknown page AA key is not exposed as an action trigger.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A page annotation A entry reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The E trigger in annotation AA reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: annotation_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A form-field trigger name in ordinary annotation AA is not exposed.

atomic_action_cases.name: outline_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An outline item A entry reaches a JavaScript action.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A forbidden action is reached through a dictionary-valued Next entry.

atomic_action_cases.name: next_action_array
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A forbidden action is reached among dictionary entries in a Next array.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_forbidden
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Named is an allowed action type but Print is a forbidden named action.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_missing
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Named action has no N value.

atomic_action_cases.name: named_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A string-valued N is exposed as null rather than as a named action.

atomic_action_cases.name: non_named_with_forbidden_n
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The named-action predicate is inapplicable to a URI action.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_action_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Widget containsA is raw key presence even when A is not a dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A Widget contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: widget_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Widget AA is forbidden and its E trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: text_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An AA key on a Text annotation is not a Widget violation.

atomic_action_cases.name: field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An AcroForm field contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: field_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Field AA is forbidden and its K trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: child_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A named child in a form-field Kids array is itself a field.

atomic_action_cases.name: child_without_t
atomic_action_cases.rationale: A child dictionary without T is not instantiated as a PDFormField.

atomic_action_cases.name: top_field_without_t
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Every dictionary directly in AcroForm Fields instantiates a top-level field.

atomic_action_cases.name: unreferenced_field_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: An unreferenced field-looking dictionary is outside the AcroForm model.

atomic_action_cases.name: combined_widget_field_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: One dictionary reached from both page Annots and AcroForm Fields instantiates both Widget and field predicates.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_actions
atomic_action_cases.rationale: The document catalog contains an empty AA dictionary.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_javascript
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog AA is forbidden and its WC trigger reaches JavaScript.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_unknown_additional_action
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog AA key presence fails while an unknown trigger does not expose its value as an action.

atomic_action_cases.name: catalog_additional_actions_wrong_type
atomic_action_cases.rationale: Catalog containsAA is raw key presence even when AA is not a dictionary.

atomic_form_cases.name: baseline
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An AcroForm with NeedAppearances false and a page Widget with an AP dictionary satisfy both pinned predicates.

atomic_form_cases.name: no_acroform
atomic_form_cases.rationale: Without a catalog AcroForm, the NeedAppearances predicate is inapplicable.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_absent
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An absent NeedAppearances key is exposed as null and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_false_indirect
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored false boolean passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_true
atomic_form_cases.rationale: NeedAppearances true is forbidden.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_true_indirect
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored true boolean remains forbidden.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_wrong_type
atomic_form_cases.rationale: veraPDF exposes a present non-boolean NeedAppearances value as true.

atomic_form_cases.name: need_appearances_null
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An explicit null is treated as an empty value and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: acroform_wrong_type
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A non-dictionary-based AcroForm value creates no PDAcroForm model object.

atomic_form_cases.name: acroform_stream_true
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A stream is dictionary-based in the pinned catalog model, so its true NeedAppearances value is evaluated.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A page Widget without AP fails the appearance-presence predicate.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_empty_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An empty AP dictionary exists for §6.9 test 2 but separately fails the allowed-entry predicate.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_wrong_type_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A scalar AP value is exposed as null.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_stream_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: AP must resolve specifically to a dictionary; a stream is exposed as null.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_indirect_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An indirect AP dictionary is resolved and passes.

atomic_form_cases.name: non_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: The §6.9 appearance-presence rule is instantiated only for Widget annotations.

atomic_form_cases.name: field_only_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A Widget-looking AcroForm field not reached from page Annots does not instantiate PDWidgetAnnot.

atomic_form_cases.name: direct_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: A direct Widget dictionary in page Annots is evaluated.

atomic_form_cases.name: widget_parent_ap_only
atomic_form_cases.rationale: AP is not inherited from a Widget parent.

atomic_form_cases.name: unreferenced_widget_missing_ap
atomic_form_cases.rationale: An unreferenced Widget-looking dictionary is outside the page annotation model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: baseline
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A catalog with neither an EmbeddedFiles name-tree entry nor OCProperties passes both document-level prohibitions.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_empty
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An empty Names dictionary has no EmbeddedFiles entry.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A dictionary-based Names value containing EmbeddedFiles fails the name-tree prohibition.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned CosDocument predicate tests EmbeddedFiles key presence without validating its value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null value is normalized as an absent dictionary entry by the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_embedded_files_indirect_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect value keeps the EmbeddedFiles key present even when its target is null.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_stream_embedded_files
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Names must resolve specifically to a dictionary; a stream does not instantiate the predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A scalar Names value is not a dictionary-based name tree.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: names_indirect_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect dictionary Names value is resolved before checking EmbeddedFiles.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: unreferenced_names_embedded_files
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An unreferenced name-tree-looking object is outside the catalog model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_without_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A file specification in the EmbeddedFiles name tree without EF passes the file-specification predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct file specification with EF is reached from the EmbeddedFiles name tree and fails both prohibitions.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_indirect_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect file specification is dereferenced by the name-tree model and its EF key is forbidden.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_stream_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned dictionary-based test also models a stream-valued name-tree file specification.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: file_spec_scalar
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A scalar name-tree value does not instantiate CosFileSpecification.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: embedded_files_kids_with_ef
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: File specifications in child name-tree nodes are recursively reached.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_f
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's F entry is forbidden even when the stream is otherwise unreferenced.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_ffilter
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's FFilter entry is forbidden regardless of value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_fdecodeparms
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream dictionary's FDecodeParms entry is forbidden regardless of value type.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_external_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null stream entry is empty in the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct LZWDecode stream filter is forbidden.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode_array
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Every filter in a stream Filter array participates in the pinned predicate.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzwdecode_indirect
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirectly stored LZWDecode name is resolved by the stream filter model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: stream_lzw_short_name
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The ordinary stream rule tests only LZWDecode, not the inline-image LZW alias.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_dictionary
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: Any non-empty OCProperties catalog entry instantiates the optional-content prohibition.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_wrong_type
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: The pinned presence test does not require OCProperties to be a dictionary.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A direct null catalog entry is empty in the pinned COS model.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_indirect_null
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An indirect null remains a non-empty catalog reference for the pinned presence test.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: ocproperties_stream
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: A stream-valued OCProperties entry is still present.

atomic_document_feature_cases.name: unreferenced_catalog_ocproperties
atomic_document_feature_cases.rationale: An unreferenced catalog-like dictionary does not affect the document catalog model.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: baseline
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: The ordinary atomic document contains no object that exceeds the six directly practical §6.1.12 bounds.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: object_limits_at_boundary
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: Each practical PDF/A-1 §6.1.12 value bound is inclusive at its maximum permitted size or magnitude.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: object_real_high
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: A real greater than 32,767 fails §6.1.12 test 2.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: object_real_low
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: A real less than -32,767 fails §6.1.12 test 2.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: object_dictionary_key_long
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: A dictionary key is outside the pinned CosName model used by §6.1.12 test 4.

atomic_object_limit_cases.name: object_dictionary_long_nulls
atomic_object_limit_cases.rationale: The pinned COS dictionary size omits direct null entries.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: baseline
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The raw-syntax baseline has valid classic xref syntax, trailer identification, and an in-range null probe.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: duplicate_last_null
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A duplicate dictionary key whose final value is null does not expose the overwritten integer in the pinned COS model.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: duplicate_last_invalid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The last duplicate dictionary value wins and exposes the out-of-range integer.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: escaped_name_at_boundary
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: Hex escapes are decoded before the 127-byte CosName limit is evaluated.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: escaped_name_over_boundary
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A name whose decoded internal representation is 128 bytes exceeds the pinned bound.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: literal_string_at_boundary
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: Literal-string escapes decode to exactly 65,535 bytes.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: literal_string_over_boundary
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: Literal-string escapes decode to 65,536 bytes and exceed the pinned bound.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: hex_string_invalid_character
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: Both validators recover an invalid hexadecimal character as a modeled conformance failure.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: hex_string_odd
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: An odd raw hexadecimal digit count is retained after value decoding.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: incremental_stale_invalid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A superseded out-of-range integer in an older revision is outside the active COS object graph.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: incremental_active_invalid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The active replacement object in the newest revision supplies the modeled integer.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: empty_trailer_id
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The pinned trailer-ID accessor returns a non-null empty string for an empty ID array.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: single_trailer_id
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The pinned accessor warns about cardinality but still exposes a one-string ID array.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: wrong_type_trailer_id
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A non-array trailer ID is absent from the pinned CosDocument model.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_direct_length_valid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A direct stream length equal to the raw data extent passes.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_direct_length_mismatch
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A direct stream length differs from the raw data extent without changing EOL applicability.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_indirect_length_valid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: An indirect stream length resolves through the active object graph.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_indirect_length_mismatch
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A resolved indirect length is compared with the independent raw stream extent.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_duplicate_length_last_valid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The final duplicate Length value wins and matches the raw extent.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_duplicate_length_last_invalid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: The final duplicate Length value wins and mismatches the raw extent.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_duplicate_external_last_null
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A final direct-null duplicate removes the external-file entry from the pinned dictionary model.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_duplicate_external_last_invalid
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: A final non-null duplicate exposes the forbidden external-file entry.

atomic_syntax_cases.name: stream_escaped_lzw_filter
atomic_syntax_cases.rationale: Name escapes are decoded before the LZW filter internal representation is compared.
